verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Orrick publishes free startup materials: Tech Studio has 50+ forms and document generators, 300+ articles, a German incorporation questionnaire, and community members report using Orrick docs to form a company. But no item mentions vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or a local equivalent, or co-founder equity splits. The equity compensation practice page describes paid legal services, not the firm's own founder-facing materials, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right
